jobs_results.title: Associate DevOps Engineer
jobs_results.description:
Want to be a part of our team?

The Associate DevOps Engineer is the entry position within the DevOps Engineering job family. This role consults with internal clients about the software technology environment with small to medium complexity.

They translate business requirements into technology terms and develop more complex algorithms and programming code for software solutions.

The primary objective of the Associate DevOps Engineer is to design, test, implement and maintain software code that enables computer systems to perform specific tasks.

They assist with determining how technology can be applied to meet client needs.

The individual in this role will participate in the planning, design, build, test, and implementation of the assigned enterprise applications and / or systems.

They will be required to perform most of the tasks defined in the planned agile epic workload or the project, gathering facts, analysing client requirements, and then designing, building, and supporting... solutions that demonstrate the functionality to support the findings.

Working at NTT

DevOps Engineer

Introduction

Kickstart your career with NTTS’s G.L.O.W Graduate Program, the ultimate launchpad for your tech career!

G Grow in accelerated development path

L Lead yourself with purpose & commitment

O Own your career journey

W Way Forward

Our comprehensive one-year program is tailored to empower talented and driven graduates like you with valuable hands-on experience, exposure to industry experts, and a diverse range of projects that will sharpen your skills and broaden your understanding to the ICT industry.

Responsibilities :

Working with senior members of the development team on complex projects that require multiple steps in the software development process.

Develop high-quality and scalable software solution.

Cooperate with team members to achieve project goals.

Adhere to best practices in software development.

Stay up to date on the latest trends and technologies in the industry.

Take ownership of small parts of the project and see them through to completion.

Help troubleshoot and debug applications.

Develop expertise in building the CICD pipeline.

Develop expertise in at least one Cloud Computing platform.

Ability to collaborate with team members, developers, QA and ownership teams to resolve issues

Requirements :

Bachelor’s Degree, preferably in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering or related field

Fresh graduate or less than 3 years of working experience

Proficiency in at least one programming language (Python, Powershell. Ruby, Bash, etc)

Familiarity with operating systems like Windows and / or Linux

Understanding of algorithms, data structures and software design patterns

Strong in interpersonal skills

Has excellent verbal / written communication and presentation skills

Team player, resourcefulness, strong analytical skills is an advantage

Skills Summary

Automation Scripting, CI / CD, Cloud Platform, Communication, Container Orchestration, Cross-Team Collaboration, Security Compliance

What will make you a good fit for the role?

Workplace type :

Equal Opportunity Employer

NTT is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer with a global culture that embraces diversity. We are committed to providing an environment free of unfair discrimination and harassment.

We do not discriminate based on age, race, color, sex, religion, national origin, disability, pregnancy, marital status, sexual orientation, gender reassignment, veteran status, or other protected category

jobs_results.title: Cloud DevOps Engineer
jobs_results.description:
¡Únete al equipo de Operaciones Gluon como Cloud DevOps Engineer en un emocionante entorno de trabajo remoto 100%!

Como Cloud DevOps Engineer en el equipo de Operaciones Gluon, serás responsable del desarrollo de soluciones y operación, garantizando que la plataforma Gluon cumpla con los más altos estándares de seguridad y rendimiento. Tus funciones principales incluirán:
• Operación de la Plataforma Gluon en Cloud AWS, Azure y herramientas ALM como Github, Atlassian Jira & Confluence, SonarQube, Nexus, Cloudbees, JFrog y Hashicorp Vault.
• Despliegue de la Plataforma Gluon en Cloud Pública.
• Automatización de procesos para mejorar la eficiencia operativa.
• Garantizar que las soluciones cumplan con los requisitos de seguridad y los SLAs del servicio.

Requisitos:
• Experiencia sólida en Cloud Pública y Privada, con preferencia en AWS y Azure.
• Experto en el desarrollo de soluciones utilizando Terraform.
• Conocimientos avanzados en Kubernetes, incluyendo Docker, Openshift, AKS... EKS, ECR y Helm.
• Experiencia en herramientas de ALM como Github Actions, Nexus Sonatype, JFrog, SonarQube y Vault.
• Habilidad para desarrollar automatizaciones utilizando Python y Ansible.

Skills Valorables:
• Experiencia en metodologías ágiles como SCRUM y Kanban.
• Excelentes habilidades de comunicación oral y escrita en inglés.
• Capacidad analítica para resolver problemas complejos y tomar decisiones informadas.

¡Si eres un apasionado del desarrollo de soluciones en la nube y buscas un desafío emocionante en un entorno remoto, esta es tu oportunidad! ¡Únete a nuestro equipo y sé parte de un ambiente colaborativo y estimulante! Envía tu CV ahora y comienza tu próxima aventura profesional con nosotros

jobs_results.title: Senior DevOps Engineer
jobs_results.description:
Senior DevOps Engineer (Barcelona/Hybrid)

About The Role

As the Senior DevOps Engineer you will be part of the Infrastructure Team, which is responsible for the day-to-day operation for all of Boats Group’s Infrastructure. As a Team, we support the infrastructure for hosted software for end-users, clients, and internal software. As such we support software development, deployment and hosting inside our AWS environment.

You will work closely with the Software Development, Business Intelligence, Customization, and AdOps Teams in supporting a varied mix of Java, PHP, Scala, Perl and Node.JS applications.

You’ll be responsible with helping to assess our current development and deployment processes, designing and documenting a migration plan to a more native AWS solution, and then helping the team successfully implement it. We would like the role to become a key voice on our Architecture Committee.

A successful candidate should be a seasoned developer who understands AWS inside and... out and how to build robust, secure and efficient environments. You need to be knowledgeable across a wide variety of technologies, front-end, back-end and all sorts of middleware.

Every day is something new and complex, you won’t be bored!

What You'll Do
• Ensure the smooth operation of our AWS infrastructure
• Participate in our coverage for outages
• Continuously monitor and improve our overall performance, monitoring, and security
• Assist in the maintenance and improvement of our deployment pipelines
• Assist developers with access and deployment issues as required
• Monitor, maintain and improve high-performance websites
• Create tools to automate all the things
• Monitor and help control AWS infrastructure spending

What You Must Have
• Considerable experience in Infrastructure or Dev support role
• Experience as a DevOps Engineer in a 300+ instance AWS environment
• Degree in Computer Science or equivalent experience
• Current with DevOps best practices, including security, monitoring and notifications
• Deep familiarity with the AWS CLI
• Qualified candidates must be eligible to work in the EU without employer sponsorship.

What You Should Have
• Experience in the following System/Tools:
• Jenkins/Groovy/Python
• CI/CD with Jenkins, Groovy, and git
• Queuing systems (ActiveMQ, RabbitMQ, AWS SQS)
• Databases (AWS RDS Aurora MySQL, MySQL, DynamoDB, DocumentDB)
• AWS Services
• ECS/ECR/Docker
• Systems Manager/Parameter Store
• EC2/ASG/ALB
• ElasticSearch
• DynamoDB
• Step Functions
• Route53
• VPC
• Comfortable with database administration and SQL
• Prior experience as a developer is extremely helpful
• AWS Professional Certification

Perks

You’ll be joining a close knit and talented team, with plenty of opportunity for professional growth. We offer competitive compensation + benefits that are on par with large companies, while also placing a high value on maintaining a healthy work-life balance.
• Shiny new Apple Macbook + large second monitor + other office accessories
• All Country holidays
• End of year holiday week break
• Birthday PTO (You never have to work on your birthday!)
• Medical insurance offered
• Meal and Travel voucher program
• 32 hours of volunteer time paid per year (We are big into volunteering and helping out the community here at Boats Group!)
• Professional reimbursement program for employees to take courses, attend seminars, etc. (Things to enrich you as a professional

jobs_results.title: Midlevel DevOps Engineer @ Deutsche Telekom
jobs_results.description:
Company Description

At T-Systems, you will find groundbreaking projects that contribute to social and ecological well-being. We want to welcome new talents like you, who bring fresh ideas, different perspectives, embrace challenges, and are committed to continuous learning in order to grow and make an impact on society... all in a fun way!

It doesn't matter when or where you work. It's about doing meaningful work that advances society. For this reason, we will do everything possible to ensure that you have all the development opportunities by providing a support network, excellent technology, a new work environment, and the freedom to work autonomously. We support you in growing both personally and professionally so that you can make a notable impact on society.

T-Systems is a team of around 28,000 employees worldwide, making us one of the leading global providers of end-to-end integrated solutions. We develop hybrid cloud solutions, artificial intelligence, and drive the digital... transformation of companies, industries, the public sector, and ultimately, society as a whole.

Job Description

The digital society wouldn’t be possible without us. Our employees provide our customers with the best network, with a reliable and secure infrastructure. The basis for tomorrow's innovations. We have the best prospects for the digital future. For you right from the start.

The company Deutsche Telekom Technik GmbH is a 100 percent subsidiary of Telekom Deutschland GmbH and provides the nationwide technical infrastructure of the group. Around 19,000 employees at DT Technik plan, design, build and operate the facilities and systems of the technical infrastructure nationwide on behalf of Telekom Deutschland GmbH. The company implements network projects, operates the network technology and, if necessary, takes over the maintenance of the technical infrastructure.

The Tribe Voice & Messaging is responsible for the design, development, planning, validation and operation of all voice and messaging platforms in DT Technik's fixed and mobile network over their entire lifecycle. We provide innovative, reliable state-of-the-art services to our cellular- and landline-based customers.

The scope of a current program is to bring voice & messaging applications into the cloud. We’ll change the today’s model of separated fixed and mobile systems and merge them. That’s why we want you on our team.

Activity description and concrete tasks:
• You will support project teams in the development, quality assurance and planning as well as implementation of product releases.
• You will design further automations of services, processes and/or operating models, you will carry out performance analyses and tunings as well as error analysis and fixes
• You will support the automation of deployments in all environments
• You will provide a project-specific infrastructure and tool suite for integration and delivery, and administer these
• You manage projects

Qualifications

You are characterized by the following knowledge and skills:
• Expert knowledge in agile development methods (like Kanban, Scrum, etc.)
• In-depth knowledge of DevOps technologies and tools (e.g. Gitlab, Docker, Kubernetes, Helm, Flux, Test Automation using Python/ behave or Ruby/Cucumber, Zabbix)
• Detailed knowledge of the market, technology and competitive environment in the information technology and telecommunications industry, including digital transformation

Nice to have skills:
• Understanding German would be helpful (optional)
• Basic IMS knowledge with relevant communication protocols (e.g. SIP and RTP) and Telecommunications Industry experience preferred
• Experience in IT project management

Tools & Platforms:

GitLab, Docker, Kubernetes, Helm, Flux, Test Automation using Python/ behave or Ruby/Cucumber, Zabbix

Additional Information

What do we offer you?

- International, positive, dynamic, and motivated work environment.

- Hybrid work model (telework/face-to-face).

- Flexible schedule.

- Continuous training.

- Flexible Compensation Plan.

- Life and accident insurance.

- More than 25 working days of vacation per year.

And many more advantages of being part of T-Systems!

If you are looking for a new challenge, do not hesitate to send us your CV! Please send CV in English. Join our team!

T-Systems Iberia will only process the CVs of candidates who meet the requirements specified for each offer

jobs_results.title: Senior DevOps Engineer
jobs_results.description:
We want to make work and study more efficient and enjoyable, by providing the best digital paper solution possible. We plan to be the go-to tool for all forms of notes. Our digital paper and learning ecosystem inspires anyone to take notes, share what they know, collaborate with others, and learn as a community

We want to make work and study more efficient and enjoyable, by providing the best digital paper solution possible. We plan to be the go-to tool for all forms of notes. Our digital paper and learning ecosystem inspires anyone to take notes, share what they know, collaborate with others, and learn as a community.

Our Values:

Dream big

—Be visionary, strategic, and open to innovation

Build great things

—Work in service of our users, always improving and pushing higher

Take ownership

—Take responsibility with bold decision-making and bias for action

Win like a sports team

—Be trusting and collaborative while empowering others

Learn and grow fast

—Never stop learning... and iterate fast

Share our passion

—Share ideas and practice enthusiasm and joy

Be user obsessed

—Empathetic, inquisitive, practical

Use the latest tech stack
• Monitoring and Logging: we are currently using Datadog for monitoring, APM, logging, CI/CD optimization, Budget and cost management. Metrics are collected across our agents, taken from the logs using metric filters, and updated directly from lambda function or the application.
• Infrastructure-as-Code: most of our infrastructure is written and defined in Terraform using Atlantis
• CI/CD: we are currently using GitHub Actions for our backend applications, and CircleCI for our iOS applications.
• Deployments: we have multiple EKS clusters set up either for Blue/Green rollouts or dedicated feature sets. We manage the workload configurations using ArgoCD and Helm.
• We are currently running dedicated stateful clusters for our CockroachDB deployments.

About the role:

Do you believe in automating yourselves out of our jobs? With our company growth, that’s not going to happen anytime soon. Join a fast-growing and talented DevOps team to build a modern, strong and stable platform to accelerate the rolling out of many new features, for millions of users around the world!

This is the role for you, if you’re excited to work on the things listed below:
• Design, build, and maintain the GoodNotes infrastructure, ensure it adheres to Dickerson’s Hierarchy of Reliability.
• Educate the various teams in DevOps and SRE best practices. Aid them, from designing, capacity planning, to rolling out new features.
• Be the go-to person for higher-level escalation for applications
• Improve the system monitoring, health reporting, and logging
• Design and implement security, assist in maintaining information security practices and procedures

The skills you will need to be successful in the above:
• Ideally 10+ years of experience in the Industry
• Deep understanding of Linux and Networking fundamentals.
• Strong knowledge of network and container security.
• Extensive experience working with AWS products.
• Proficiency in container orchestration, with a particular emphasis on Kubernetes.
• Proven track record in building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines.
• Solid experience in managing Relational and Non-relational databases, including backup and restore operations.
• Familiarity with distributed databases.
• Proficiency in automation/configuration management tools, preferably CDK and/or Terraform.
• Proficiency in scripting languages, particularly TypeScript.
• Familiarity with system monitoring tools.
• Some background in back-end development, including API usage and creation.

Even if you don’t meet all the criteria listed above, we would still love to hear from you! GoodNotes places a lot of value on learning and development and will support your growth if needed.

The interview process:
• An introductory call with someone from our talent acquisition team. They want to hear more about your background, what you are looking for, and why you’d like to join Goodnotes
• A take-home challenge to set up an end-to-end CI/CD pipeline for an API.
• A live coding call with one of our engineers. This is where you get to see what it would be like working at Goodnotes as well as the chance to ask any engineering questions you may have
• A one-hour call with your hiring manager. This is the person who will be managing you day to day, working on your growth and development with you as well as support you throughout your career at Goodnotes
• A one-hour call with 2-3 stakeholders you’d work closely with

What’s in it for you:
• Meaningful equity in a profitable tech-startup
• Budget for things like noise-cancelling headphones, setting up your home office, personal development, professional training, and health & wellness
• Sponsored visits to our Hong Kong or London office every 2 years
• Company-wide annual offsite
• Flexible working hours and location
• Medical insurance for you and your dependents

• Proficiency in scripting languages, particularly TypeScript.
• Familiarity with system monitoring tools.
• Some background in back-end development, including API usage and creation.

Even if you don’t meet all the criteria listed above, we would still love to hear from you! GoodNotes places a lot of value on learning and development and will support your growth if needed.

The interview process:
• An introductory call with someone from our talent acquisition team. They want to hear more about your background, what you are looking for, and why you’d like to join Goodnotes
• A take-home challenge to set up an end-to-end CI/CD pipeline for an API.
• A live coding call with one of our engineers. This is where you get to see what it would be like working at Goodnotes as well as the chance to ask any engineering questions you may have
• A one-hour call with your hiring manager. This is the person who will be managing you day to day, working on your growth and development with you as well as support you throughout your career at Goodnotes
• A one-hour call with 2-3 stakeholders you’d work closely with

What’s in it for you:
• Meaningful equity in a profitable tech-startup
• Budget for things like noise-cancelling headphones, setting up your home office, personal development, professional training, and health & wellness
• Sponsored visits to our Hong Kong or London office every 2 years
• Company-wide annual offsite
• Flexible working hours and location
• Medical insurance for you and your dependents

jobs_results.title: Cloud-Experte mit Schwerpunkt auf Azure und DevOps
jobs_results.location: San Sebastián de los Reyes, Spain
jobs_results.via: via Mercedes-Benz Group > Careers > Job Search
jobs_results.description:
Aufgaben

Beschreibung der Position

Als Cloud-Experte stehen Sie an der Spitze der Cloud-Computing-Strategie unseres Unternehmens und spielen eine zentrale Rolle bei der Planung, Konzeption und Implementierung innovativer Cloud-Lösungen.

Mit Ihrem Fachwissen leiten Sie die Umsetzung komplexer Geschäftsanforderungen in effiziente und skalierbare Cloud-Strategien und gewährleisten die Optimierung und Sicherheit unserer Cloud-Infrastruktur. Sie sind verantwortlich für die Entwicklung und Pflege automatisierter Prozesse zur Verbesserung der Systemleistung und bieten fachkundige Beratung zu Cloud-Technologien und Best Practices.

Ihre Aufgabe umfasst die aktive Zusammenarbeit mit verschiedenen Teams, einschließlich der IT-Sicherheitsabteilung, um die Einhaltung von Vorschriften und den Datenschutz zu gewährleisten und gleichzeitig durch Schulungen und Zertifizierungen zur kontinuierlichen Verbesserung unserer Cloud-Fähigkeiten beizutragen. Sie werden eine Schlüsselrolle bei der Förderung... des Erfolgs unserer Organisation in einer dynamischen und sich schnell entwickelnden technologischen Landschaft spielen.

Beschreibung der Rolle und der Aufgaben
• Planung, Design und Implementierung von Cloud-Lösungen zur Verbesserung von Technologien und Kundenerfahrungen.
• Umwandlung von Geschäftsanforderungen in effiziente Cloud-Strategien.
• Pflege und Ausbau der bestehenden Cloud-Infrastruktur.
• Entwicklung von Automatisierungsprozessen zur Steigerung der Effizienz und Leistung in der Cloud-Umgebung.
• Beratung von Kunden und Teams zu Cloud-Technologien, Best Practices und Optimierungsmöglichkeiten.
• Zusammenarbeit mit IT-Sicherheitsteams für Datensicherheit und Compliance.
• Fortlaufende Schulung und Zertifizierung in Cloud-Technologien.
• Gleichgewicht zwischen Betrieb und Entwicklung.
• Entwurf und Bereitstellung von Integrationen als Services, Automatisierung von API-gesteuerten Systemen in agilen Liefermodellen.
• Aufbau und Entwicklung moderner hybrider Cloud-Infrastrukturen und -Services.
• Einrichten von automatisierten Tests in CI/CD-Lösungen.
• Zu den Aufgaben gehören das Konfigurationsmanagement, die Ressourcenzuweisung, die Optimierung der Leistungskapazität, das Management der Compliance und die Sicherstellung der Einhaltung von Service Level Agreements

Qualifikationen

Bildungsabschluss und technische Erfahrung

Bachelor- oder Master-Abschluss in Informatik, IT, Softwaretechnik oder einem verwandten Bereich.

Technische Kenntnisse/Verantwortlichkeiten

- Entwurf, Implementierung und Wartung hochverfügbarer und skalierbarer Cloud-basierter Systeme in Azure

- Analysieren von Geschäftsanforderungen und Umwandeln in effiziente Cloud-Strategien

- Beratung von Kunden und internen Teams zu Cloud-Technologien, bewährten Verfahren und Optimierungsmöglichkeiten

- Zusammenarbeit mit IT-Sicherheitsteams zur Gewährleistung von Datensicherheit und Compliance

- Definition von Infrastruktur als Code mit Terraform

- Entwicklung von wiederverwendbaren Terraform-Modulen

- Verwaltung von Code-Repositories und CI/CD-Pipelines

- Überwachung der Systemleistung und proaktives Erkennen und Beheben von Problemen

- Entwicklung und Pflege der Dokumentation für Systemarchitektur, Prozesse und Verfahren

- Kontinuierliche Bewertung und Verbesserung der Systemarchitektur, um optimale Leistung und Skalierbarkeit zu gewährleisten

- Mehrere Zertifizierungen in Cloud-Technologien (Azure Solution Architect, Azure DevOps Engineer, Azure Administrator usw.) sind von großem Vorteil.

- Erfahrung in einer ähnlichen Funktion, die praktische Erfahrung mit Cloud-Lösungen erkennen lässt

- Eingehende Kenntnisse von Terraform, Github

- Ausgeprägtes Verständnis von Netzwerkkonzepten, einschließlich DNS, TCP/IP und Lastausgleich

- Gute Kenntnisse in der Konfiguration und Wartung von Linux- und Windows-Servern

- Erfahrung mit der Erstellung und Verwaltung von Azure Data Factories für die Datenintegration mit Integrationslaufzeiten

- Vertrautheit mit Programmier-/Skriptsprachen wie Python, Bash, PowerShell, Azure CLI usw.

- Kenntnisse in der Konfiguration von DNS- und Netzwerkeinstellungen

- Kenntnisse in der Implementierung von Überwachungslösungen wie Azure Monitor, Application Insights, DataDog, Grafana, Icinga

- Nachgewiesene Fähigkeit zur Ursachenanalyse, Untersuchung, Diagnose und Berichterstattung

- Grundlegende Kenntnisse in ITIL, SCRUM, KanBan und DevOps-Grundsätzen

- Solides Verständnis der Grundsätze der Containerisierung mit Docker und Kubernetes mit praktischer Erfahrung

Englisch

Lesen, Schreiben und fließende Konversation

Andere Sprache

Deutsch ist wünschenswert: Lesen, Schreiben und Konversation hilfreich.

Andere Präferenzen

Neben technischem Fachwissen sollte der ideale Kandidat über eine Reihe wichtiger Soft Skills verfügen, darunter die Fähigkeit, sich schnell auf neue Situationen einzustellen, ein ausgeprägtes Verantwortungsbewusstsein, die Förderung von Vertrauen und Inspiration, eine ko-kreative Denkweise, die von kollaborativer Innovation lebt, ein unermüdliches Streben nach Leistung und Erfolg, eine unerschütterliche Kundenorientierung, die darauf abzielt, unsere Kunden immer wieder aufs Neue zu begeistern, eine tief verwurzelte Zielstrebigkeit, ein Pioniergeist, der Innovationen begrüßt, und die Bereitschaft, sich ständig weiterzubilden, um an der Spitze des Fortschritts der Branche zu bleiben.

All diese Fähigkeiten sind als "People Principles" in den Mercedes-Benz Karrierepfad für unsere kontinuierliche Entwicklung aufgenommen worden

jobs_results.title: DevOps Engineer
jobs_results.description:
Since its foundation in 1925, the DEKRA promise has been to ensure the safety of human interaction with technology and the environment. DEKRA achieved revenues of around €3.1 billion in 2017. The company currently employs around 47,000 people in more than 50 countries on all five continents.

We have a clear and ambitious vision of the future. The vision for our 100th birthday in 2025 is to see DEKRA as the global partner for a safe world.
An exciting opportunity has arisen in our DIGITAL & PS Division. This area is to focus on tech competencies and drive digital innovation to help leading DEKRA into a successful future.

We are currently looking for a Senior DevOps Engineer to strengthen our DIGITAL & PS area.

Qualifications:

Tasks/Responsabilities:
• Deployment of infrastructure in production environments.
• Design, implementation, and maintenance of internal continuous integration infrastructure.
• Implementation of monitoring systems in clients.
• Collaboration in the search for... new solutions for the continuous improvement of internal and external infrastructure and processes.

Your Profile:
• Bachelor Degree in Computer Science or similar.
• At least 1-3 years of experience in DevOps.
• Experience in infrastructure design and development as code.
• In-depth knowledge of deployment automation tools such as Ansible, Terraform, or Chef.
• Experience in system monitoring and maintenance.
• Demostrable experience in the installation and maintenance of container orchestration systems, such as Kubernetes or similar distributions.
• Knowledge in virtualization systems such as Proxmox, VMware, or OpenStack.
• Basic knowledge in networks.
• Passion for automation and continuous improvement of processes.
• Strong communication skills and team work skills.

Other Info:
• Where’s the position based? Málaga or Madrid.

We offer you an excellent opportunity to grow and develop your career in a leading multinational organization. For more information about us or what we do, visit
#J-18808-Ljbffr
